What is a Body Hair Transplant?

When the Scalp Can’t Donate—The Body Steps In

Body hair transplant (BHT) uses hairs from areas like the beard, chest, or back to fill in scalp baldness, especially when scalp donor supply is limited.
In a body hair transplant, grafts are taken from areas such as the beard, chest, shoulders, or back and implanted into balding areas on the scalp.

It’s especially helpful for patients with advanced hair loss, poor scalp donor density, or those needing repair procedures after failed transplants.

The technique is performed using FUE, ensuring minimal scarring and natural-looking results.

How Body Hair Transplant Works

A Precision Procedure That Maximizes Every Graft

We extract healthy grafts from body areas using FUE and implant them into your scalp for improved density.
✅ Step 1: Consultation & Hair Mapping
We assess your scalp and body hair to determine which areas are suitable for graft extraction.
✅ Step 2: FUE Graft Extraction
Using tiny punch tools, we extract hair follicles from the beard, chest, or other approved donor zones.
✅ Step 3: Implantation into Scalp
Grafts are implanted into balding areas just like in a traditional transplant, with attention to direction and density.
✅ Step 4: Recovery & Regrowth
Mild redness fades in a few days. Results start to appear in 3–4 months and continue improving for up to a year.
